reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body: ## Pull request overview This PR aims to deprecate the `featureInvariantsV1_1` amendment by switching the `AccountRootsDeletedClean` invariant’s enforcement gate to `fixCleanup3_2_0`, and removing `InvariantsV1_1` from the amendment registry. **Changes:** - Update invariant enforcement gating from `featureInvariantsV1_1` to the Cleanup 3.2.0 fix amendment. - Update invariant test default amendments accordingly. - Remove the `InvariantsV1_1` amendment entry from `features.macro`. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | src/test/app/Invariants_test.cpp | Updates default amendment set for invariant tests to use the Cleanup 3.2.0 fix instead of `featureInvariantsV1_1`. | | src/libxrpl/tx/invariants/InvariantCheck.cpp | Changes the `AccountRootsDeletedClean` enforcement gate to use Cleanup 3.2.0. | | include/xrpl/protocol/detail/features.macro | Removes the `InvariantsV1_1` amendment from the feature registry. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. Learn how to get started.

reviews.author: ximinez
reviews.body: Because `featureInvariantsV1_1` was never marked supported, this PR is _nearly_ trivial. I can't believe it's close to three years, and only one invariant was implemented under it.

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: `Cleanup3_2_0` is not the generated amendment identifier for this fix. `XRPL_FIX(Cleanup3_2_0, ...)` generates `fixCleanup3_2_0` (see `Feature.h` macros), so this line will not compile and also doesn’t match how other fixes are referenced in tests (e.g. `fixSecurity3_1_3`). Use `fixCleanup3_2_0` here instead.

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: `XRPL_FIX(Cleanup3_2_0, ...)` generates the symbol `fixCleanup3_2_0`, not `Cleanup3_2_0` (see `Feature.h` where `XRPL_FIX(name,...)` declares `extern uint256 const fix##name`). As written this won’t compile and won’t correctly gate enforcement on the intended amendment. Switch to `view.rules().enabled(fixCleanup3_2_0)`.

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: Removing `InvariantsV1_1` from the feature registry can make the server treat that amendment as unknown. If the amendment ever appears in a validated ledger’s Amendments object (or is configured/voted in the wild), Feature.h notes that removing a feature definition can cause nodes to become amendment blocked. Consider keeping the identifier registered (e.g., move it to the retired section via `XRPL_RETIRE_FEATURE(InvariantsV1_1)` or otherwise deprecate it) instead of deleting it outright.

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body: @mvadari you will want to swap their order too, since the security amendment will be renamed to "cleanup" as well. By swapping their order it will just be more aesthetically pleasing.
